Package com.recruitment.service

Class JobService

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.service.JobService
public class JobService extends Object
Service layer for managing job postings.

Handles CRUD operations, filtering, searching, sorting, statistics, and automatic expiration checks. Coordinates with ApplicationService and NotificationService when closing expired jobs.

Data is persisted in data/jobs.json via JsonUtil. An in-memory list is loaded at construction and written back on each mutating operation.

    • checkExpiredJobs

      public void checkExpiredJobs()
      Scans all OPEN jobs and closes any whose deadline has passed or is today.

      For each expired job, sends a Notification.Type.POSITION_EXPIRATION notification to every applicant who still has a Application.Status.PENDING application.

      Called periodically by a background timer in Main. Requires both applicationService and notificationService to be injected before invocation; otherwise a NullPointerException may occur.
